info.title: Reverse Geocoding API - Convert Coordinates to a Street Address
info.description: Convert a WGS84 latitude/longitude pair into a single human-readable address or place name. Returns the nearest matching location's structured address components (street, city, state, country), a bounding box, and any points of interest, such as a shop or building, at that location. Use the `Accept-Language` header to localize the returned name and address fields to a preferred language, falling back to `en` if the language isn't supported. Both `lat` (-90 to 90) and `lon` (-180 to 180) are required; missing, non-numeric, or out-of-range values return a `400` error.

get.summary: Convert coordinates into a human-readable address
get.description: Look up the nearest address or place name for a given latitude and longitude pair.

parameters.name: lat
parameters.description: WGS84 latitude value, ranging from -90 to 90.

parameters.name: lon
parameters.description: WGS84 longitude value, ranging from -180 to 180.

parameters.name: Accept-Language
parameters.description: Preferred language order for the result name and address, as a comma-separated list of language codes or a single code. Results are returned in the first matched language, falling back to `en` if none match.

value.name: LensCrafters
value.full_address: LensCrafters, 7, West 34th Street, Midtown South, Manhattan Community Board 5, Manhattan, New York County, New York, 10001, United States

400.description: Bad Request — Invalid or missing parameters

nonNumericValue.summary: `lat` or `lon` is not a valid number

ApiKeyAuthHeader.name: X-apiKey
ApiKeyAuthHeader.description: Pass your API key via the X-apiKey request header.

ApiKeyAuthQuery.name: apiKey
ApiKeyAuthQuery.description: Pass your API key via the apiKey query parameter.

error.description: Short error category or exception type.

message.description: Human-readable error message describing the failure.

path.description: API endpoint path that produced the error.

status.description: HTTP status code returned with the error.

GeocodeResponse.description: The nearest geocoded location to the given coordinates, with structured address components.

lat.description: WGS84 latitude value for the location.

lon.description: WGS84 longitude value for the location.

name.description: Name for the primary place searched.

category.description: High-level category of the place, e.g. amenity, place, natural, building, highway.

type.description: Specific kind within the category, e.g. fast_food, city, park, residential, house_number.

poi.description: Points of interest at this location.

area.description: Intra-city area below city level, e.g. suburb, borough, quarter, ward, district, sector, zone, tehsil, taluka, neighbourhood.

city.description: Settlement label appropriate to the country, e.g. city, town, municipality.

county.description: Second-tier administrative area, e.g. county, district, shire, prefecture.

state_code.description: Subdivision code when available, typically ISO-3166-2 (e.g. US-TX, PK-PB).

state.description: First-tier administrative area; varies by country, e.g. state, region, province, division, autonomous community.

country_code.description: Two-letter country code in upper case, ISO-3166-1 alpha-2.

country.description: Country name of the searched place.

full_address.description: Single-line, human-readable address of the location.

bounding_box.description: Extent of the feature as `[lat_min, lat_max, lon_min, lon_max]` (south, north, west, east) in WGS84 decimal degrees.

PointOfInterest.description: A point of interest located at or near a geocoded result.

name.description: Name of the point of interest.

category.description: High-level category of the point of interest, e.g. amenity, place, natural, building, highway.

type.description: Specific kind within the category, e.g. fast_food, city, park, residential, house_number.

X-AF-Credits-Cost.description: Specifies the number of credits consumed by the current request.
